verdicts.flaw_description: A named alternative cause reaches every unit: "The lubricant supply moved from mineral to synthetic grade mid-cycle, and every machine here drew from that supply." A switch from mineral to synthetic grease during the same cycle would itself extend bearing life, so the 260-410 extra hours cannot be attributed to the redesigned bearing.

The measured population is narrower than the claim: "Rates cover the patients whose whole stay ran under the protocol, and a quarter of each ward's patients had spells outside the protocol." The 6-11 percent falls are computed on a selected three-quarters of each ward, so they do not establish a change in the ward infection rate the claim is about.

A competing cause covers every case: "The free trial ran eighteen days, up from ten in the earlier period, and every cohort here signed up on that trial." Extending the trial from ten to eighteen days by itself keeps users active through day fourteen, so the 3-6 point week-two retention lift cannot be credited to the onboarding email.

Two of the four cases have measurement dates that precede enrolment: cohort One "started 4 April; by 29 March resting heart rate ran 5 bpm below" and cohort Three "started 5 October; by 30 September ... 6 bpm below." The drop is recorded before the app was in use, so those readings cannot show its effect.
